questions.text: Describe a festival or public holiday in your country.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a festival or public holiday in your country. You should say: what it is called; when it takes place; what people do during it; and explain how you feel about this festival or holiday.

questions.text: Has the way you celebrate it changed since you were a child?
questions.say: Thank you. Has the way you celebrate it changed since you were a child?

questions.text: Why is it important for countries to keep their traditional festivals?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a festival or holiday in your country, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all traditions. Why is it important for countries to keep their traditional festivals?

questions.text: Do you think festivals have become too commercial?

questions.text: What are the benefits of festivals for a town's economy?
